history.summary: CDL city-fringe mixed development at Potong Pasir MRT, $1.8M for a large 1,119 sqft 2BR at $1,609 psf — below the development's recent ~$1,905 psf average, suggesting either a motivated seller or a less desirable stack. Quality CDL finishes and a genuine MRT-adjacent D13 location are real positives.
history.rating_rationale: The Venue transacted in the last 12 months at $1,694–$2,194 psf (avg ~$1,905, Nov-2025 high $2,194); this listing at $1,608 psf is ~15% below the average, a meaningful discount on a CDL development 400m from Potong Pasir MRT. 99LH from 2017 (~90 yrs left), city-fringe D13 with Orchard/CBD in minutes, and the $1.8M quantum sits in the deep buyer band. The 1,119 sqft is generous for a 2BR so verify it isn't a low-floor/expressway-facing stack, but the PSF gap gives margin.
red_flags: Listed PSF ~15% below development average — confirm it isn't a poor-facing or low-floor stack (PIE/CTE noise)
1,119 sqft is large for a 2BR, raising quantum for the bedroom count
Mixed-development maintenance fees and retail-podium footfall noise
catalysts: Direct Potong Pasir MRT (NE line) connectivity to CBD/Orchard
Below-average entry PSF vs proven $1,905 transacted average
CDL build quality and Green Mark Platinum, established 2017 development
